snippet.title: Shadows of Chroma Tower - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Check out gameplay, combat, bosses, and more from this new Shadows of Chroma Tower trailer for the upcoming action RPG. In Shadows of Chroma Tower, choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes. Shadows of Chroma Tower will be available on PC (Steam) and Xbox in March 2026.
